name: Nova Technology Corp.
summary: Nova Technology Corp. specializes in delivering tailored solutions and services to a broad spectrum of industrial manufacturers. Their clientele spans crucial sectors such as semiconductor fabrication, photonics, solar energy, biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and general chemical production. Operating across several key Asian regions, including Taiwan, China, Vietnam, Singapore, and Malaysia, the company provides a comprehensive suite of systems. These offerings include sophisticated chemical recovery and supply infrastructure, advanced bulk and specialty gas dispensing systems, and state-of-the-art wet processing stations. Furthermore, they supply chemical dispensing and packaging systems, alongside integrated solutions for green energy and environmental protection. Founded in 1997, Nova Technology Corp. is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan, and functions as a subsidiary of Acter Co., Ltd.
